product_overview: Goyone CRM is a web-based customer relationship management system that centralizes lead, task, deal, call, calendar, and invoice workflows to streamline sales and customer-facing operations. The app provides list and board views, filtering/search, and creation/editing flows with a help center for user guidance.
core_goals: Provide a searchable, filterable Lead Management interface to track prospects and communication state.
Offer task management to assign, view, and prioritize work for sales and support teams.
Support deals pipeline visualization and stage management (Kanban) for sales forecasting.
Log and review calls and schedule activities via an integrated calendar.
Enable creation and tracking of invoices for billing workflows.
Deliver help articles and documentation to reduce support friction.

features.name: Lead Management
features.description: View, search, filter, export, and update CRM leads from the main CRM dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm -> See Leads table -> Search leads via search bar -> Filter leads by status and communication state -> Click lead row to open detail view -> Edit lead fields -> Click Save -> See updated lead in table
Navigate to /crm -> Search leads via search bar with query that matches no results -> See 'No leads found' message
Navigate to /crm -> Click Export lead data -> Confirm export -> See download start
Navigate to /crm -> Click Export lead data -> API returns error -> See export error notification

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Display and filter the list of tasks, allowing users to find and manage outstanding work items.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/tasks -> View task list -> Filter and sort tasks -> Click task to open details -> Mark task complete -> See task status updated in list
Navigate to /crm/tasks -> Apply filter that returns no tasks -> See 'No tasks found' message
Navigate to /crm/tasks -> View task list -> API request fails -> See 'Failed to load tasks' error message

features.name: Invoice Management
features.description: Create, view, and manage invoices from the invoices listing page.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/invoices -> View invoice list -> Click Create new invoice -> Fill invoice form fields -> Click Save -> See new invoice in list
Navigate to /crm/invoices -> Click Create new invoice -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Save -> See validation error messages
Navigate to /crm/invoices -> View invoice list -> API returns error -> See 'Failed to load invoices' notification

features.name: Deal Pipeline (Kanban)
features.description: Visualize deals across stages in a Kanban-style board and update deal stages via drag & drop.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/deals -> See deals Kanban board -> Click deal card to open details -> Edit deal fields -> Click Save -> See deal updated on board
Navigate to /crm/deals -> See deals Kanban board -> Drag deal card to new stage -> Drop card -> See deal stage updated in UI
Navigate to /crm/deals -> Drag deal card to new stage -> Network request fails on drop -> See 'Failed to update deal stage' error and card returns to original column

features.name: Calls Log
features.description: Log, view, and filter call activity so users can review communication history.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/calls -> View calls log -> Filter calls by date or type -> Click call entry to open details -> Add call notes -> Click Save -> See notes on call entry
Navigate to /crm/calls -> Filter calls by date range that returns no results -> See 'No calls found' message
Navigate to /crm/calls -> View calls log -> API error occurs -> See 'Failed to load calls' notification

features.name: Calendar / Scheduling
features.description: View schedules and create calendar events for meetings and follow-ups.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/calender -> View monthly calendar -> Click date to create event -> Fill event details -> Click Save -> See event displayed on selected date
Navigate to /crm/calender -> Click date to create event -> Enter invalid time range -> Click Save -> See validation error 'End time must be after start time'
Navigate to /crm/calender -> View calendar -> Calendar fails to load events -> See 'Failed to load calendar events' message

features.name: Help Articles / Documentation
features.description: Browse and search help articles to find product documentation and troubleshooting guidance.
user_flows: Navigate to /crm/help-articles -> See help articles list -> Search help articles -> Click article to open -> Read article content
Navigate to /crm/help-articles -> Search help articles with no matching results -> See 'No articles found' message
Navigate to /crm/help-articles -> Click article to open -> Article content fails to load -> See 'Failed to load article' error
